text:
tara_infra: Quick sync — inventory recon and rack sequencing sprint. Need owners for: power sequencing, L2 network stitching, and reservation mapping. Procurement update below.

alex_k: I can take reservation mapping. Do we have the latest `reservations.csv`?

tara_infra: @alex_k thanks — use `s3://redwood-prod/capacity/reservations/2026-03-15.csv`. I’ll mark you as owner in the spreadsheet.

riley_dev: I’ll own power sequencing for racks 12–18. Need someone to pair on DB access to update PDUs.

sam_ops: I can pair for DB access tomorrow AM. Also FYI — procurement pushed 8x H100s to Wed EOD; manifest now shows partial shipment. :thinking_face:

mike_platform: If H100s arrive Wed, can we reassign 2 canary nodes from the staging pool? Want to avoid impacting customer SLAs.

tara_infra: Good call. @mike_platform please propose which staging instances to use (IDs or `stg-rack-*`). We’ll do a 2-node canary then scale.

alex_k: Reservation mapping note: we have a gap for customer acct 4472 between desired capacity and reserved slots. Filed a quick note in the spreadsheet row 47.

riley_dev: Power sequencing checklist (short): 1) Verify PDU firmware, 2) Reserve maintenance window, 3) Apply sequencing policy, 4) Smoke test. I’ll add the checklist to the runbook.

sam_ops: PDU firmware is only current on racks 13–15. Need vendor access for rack 12 and 16–18. Opening ticket with vendor now.

shipment-bot: shipment-tracker: Manifest updated — 4/8 H100s in transit, ETA 2026-03-18 17:30 UTC. Tracking: https://shipments.example/track/AB12345

mike_platform: Re: canary nodes — propose `stg-rack-04` and `stg-rack-07`. Low-util, same network segment as target racks. Will document rollback plan.

tara_infra: Approved. @mike_platform go ahead and schedule the canary cutover for Thu 09:00 UTC. @sam_ops coordinate vendor window for PDUs before that.

alex_k: Quick question — do we need KMS-approved keys for the new nodes or will they inherit existing cluster KMS?

mike_platform: They’ll inherit cluster KMS, but if we convert to Dedicated isolation later we’ll need per-tenant keys. Not blocking for canary.

riley_dev: I’ll link the runbook and add a short rollback `cmd` block:
```
# rollback
ansible-playbook rollback-sequence.yml -i inventory/staging
```

sam_ops: Vendor ticket created: TKT-8342. ETA for firmware access: Tue 14:00 UTC.

tara_infra: Nice. Owners summary: power sequencing -> riley_dev, DB/PDU pairing -> sam_ops, reservation mapping -> alex_k, canary -> mike_platform. I’ll update the project milestone and ping on Friday for status. :thumbsup:
